questions.prompt: An application must accept TCP connections only over privately routed networks. Which regional Load Balancer frontend fits?

options.text: An internal frontend with a private subnet IP.
options.explanation: This provides the privately reachable frontend.

options.text: A public frontend plus a public DNS name only.
options.explanation: A DNS name does not make a public frontend private.

options.text: An outbound rule without any frontend.
options.explanation: An outbound rule does not supply this inbound service endpoint.

options.text: A probe-only configuration without a load-balancing rule.
options.explanation: A probe monitors backends but does not distribute client traffic.

questions.prompt: A Standard public Load Balancer has a frontend and backend pool but no load-balancing rule. Healthy backend listeners exist. What configuration maps client TCP 443 to their TCP 8443?

options.text: Only a DNS CNAME from 443 to 8443.
options.explanation: DNS aliases do not translate TCP ports.

options.text: A load-balancing rule linking frontend, pool, protocol/ports, and probe.
options.explanation: That rule defines the distribution and port mapping.

options.text: Only an NSG outbound allow on 8443.
options.explanation: Filtering permission does not configure the frontend mapping.

options.text: Only a route table pointing to the public IP.
options.explanation: Routing does not define this load-balancing rule.

questions.prompt: A team wants requests for /images and /api sent to different backend pools according to URL path. Does Azure Load Balancer alone provide this?

options.text: Yes, by changing its TCP idle timeout.
options.explanation: Idle timeout does not parse HTTP paths.

options.text: Yes, by setting the health-probe path to both prefixes.
options.explanation: Probe paths test health; they do not route client URLs.

options.text: No; its layer-4 rules do not inspect URL paths.
options.explanation: An HTTP-aware routing service is needed for that decision.

options.text: Yes, by adding a second public IP to each backend.
options.explanation: Additional addresses do not add HTTP path inspection.
